scientific_role: public-data development preflight for known-truth whole-population structural-selector evaluation; not confirmation

pair_status_rules.SPATIAL_HOLDOUT_ELIGIBLE: population_clusters >= 3 and structural family is not GENERAL_SPATIAL_BASELINE_ONLY
pair_status_rules.BASELINE_ONLY_NO_STRUCTURAL_FAMILY: unit structural family is GENERAL_SPATIAL_BASELINE_ONLY; population counts remain reported
pair_status_rules.PROVIDER_FAILURE: species-level public occurrence retrieval failed; retain all 12 region pairs

preflight_boundary.purpose: measure whether the already-frozen Cirsium family assignments have enough strict replicated public populations to justify a later source-backed whole-population structural holdout

decision_rule.if_multiple_structural_families_have_eli: proceed to a separately frozen structural whole-population holdout without changing family formulas on these preflight counts
decision_rule.if_eligibility_is_too_sparse_or_family_c: freeze the evidence-adequacy blocker; do not manufacture a selector result by relaxing precision, cluster count, region bounds, or taxon identity

forbidden: do not choose a favorable fixed region after population counts are observed; all 156 pairs remain in the preflight artifact
do not relax the <=1 km declared uncertainty rule after observing attrition
do not reduce the >=3 population requirement after observing attrition
do not replace species or regions after provider/evidence failure
do not run or tune a structural selector in this preflight
do not reuse opened public temporal outcomes to tune family formulas
do not call this independent confirmation or prospective field validation
do not infer route, access, days, budget, discoveries per hour, or stopping
